pages.text: Each meteor has its own wood with the full set: logs, planks, stairs, slabs, fences, gates, doors, trapdoors, buttons, pressure plates and boats. Strip logs with an axe.$(br2)Saplings only grow on $(item)Glowmarl$().
pages.title: Alien Woods

pages.text: Swamp. Segmented olive reed-trees on stilt roots.
pages.title: Stiltreed

pages.text: Hive. Wax-coated amber wood with a comb pattern.
pages.title: Combwood

pages.text: Desert. Pale, leafless and spiralling like a ribcage.
pages.title: Ribwood
